Ordering furniture from China isn’t as simple as finding a cute sofa on Alibaba and hitting “add to cart.” 😂 There’s a whole process between finding the furniture and having that container sitting at your warehouse. Manufacturers. Negotiations. Production. Freight. Customs. Port fees. Final delivery. And baby… there are PLENTY of opportunities to make an expensive mistake in between. Ask me how I know. 😭😂 I’ve been importing inventory for years, and learning how to source overseas completely changed the way I was able to grow my rental inventory. So if importing is something you’re seriously considering, learn the process BEFORE you start sending people your money. I put what I’ve learned—including manufacturers I’ve actually sourced from—inside my Luxury Inventory Sourcing Blueprint. Comment IMPORT and I’ll send you the information. 💕 Learn first. Then spend.
